Summary: The full-context baseline for 2WikiMultiHopQA, as reported in "Constructing A Multi-hop QA Dataset for Comprehensive Evaluation of Reasoning Steps," achieved an Exact Match (EM) of 36.53% and a token-level F1 score of 43.93% on the test set. In contrast, "PRISM: Agentic Retrieval with LLMs for Multi-hop Question Answering" indicates that a setting with compact yet relevant context yielded an EM of 44.4% and an F1 score of 56.81 on the same dataset. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the full-wiki joint F1 baseline.

Sources:
